shortDescription: Cognex NASDAQ:CGNX said Tuesday it agreed to acquire robotics company RealSense for ~$500M in cash, advancing its strategy to diversify its growth engine by entering the robotic perception market.Originally founded by Intel in 2014 and spun out in 2025, RealSense has established a leading position…

children: robotics company RealSense for ~$500M in cash, advancing its strategy to diversify its growth engine by entering the robotic perception market.

Originally founded by Intel in 2014 and spun out in 2025, RealSense has established a leading position in 3D robotic perception, with applications across fixed arm perception-guided robotics, autonomous mobile robots, quadrupeds, and humanoids.
RealSense is expected to generate revenue of $80M-$90M in 2026, representing more than 50% growth over the prior year.
Before closing, RealSense will spin out its Facial Authentication product line into an independent company.

"Combined with Cognex's machine vision expertise and global reach, RealSense positions us to offer a full-stack visual intelligence platform, spanning industrial ID, 2D and 3D machine vision measurement to 3D depth perception and robotic navigation, built to serve the full spectrum of Physical AI," Cognex
President and CEO Matt Moschner said.

title: Cognex to buy robotics firm RealSense in $500M deal
